title: The server host key changed
fault: The injection regenerates the practice host key.
prompts: Why would a host key change on a server you manage?
What does the client refuse to do, and why?
hints: Read the warning text. It names the file and the line that holds the old key.
A changed key can mean a rebuild, or a machine in the middle.

reveal.wrong: The injection regenerated the host key, so the key in your known_hosts file no longer matches.
reveal.fix: Confirm the change was intended, then remove the old line from the scratch known_hosts file and connect again.
